A 40-year-old laborer is scheduled for total shoulder arthroplasty due to primary osteoarthritis. What is
the likelihood that he has a concomitant full-thickness tear of the supraspinatus? Answer Choices: (A) 5
to 15% (B) 20 to 30% (C) 15 to 25% (D) 10 to 20% (E) greater than 40% (F) 35 to 45% (G) less than
10% (H) greater than 50% (I) approximately 25% (J) 30 to 40%
 A. 5 to 15%
B. 20 to 30%
C. greater than 50%
D. 15 to 25%
E. approximately 25%
F. greater than 40%
G. 10 to 20%
H. 30 to 40%
I. less than 10%
J. 35 to 45%
